verdict.rationale: The failure-notification half is documented: Trigger.dev sends alerts by email, Slack and webhooks when tasks fail, and the dashboard lets you filter errored runs. Error handling is mostly shown through retry configuration, globally or per task with exponential backoff, plus plain async/await code; there is no evidence of a dedicated error-workflow or failure-handler path. Missing for 10: documented dedicated error-handling hooks or error workflows (e.g. on-failure handlers), in-depth alerting docs beyond a product-page claim, and independent corroboration of the alerts.
